javax.microedition.theme
Class ThemeMetadata

java.lang.Object
  javax.microedition.theme.ThemeMetadata

public final class ThemeMetadata
extends java.lang.Object

Stores the metadata associated with an appearance.

The metadata consists of the following items:

  • The titles of the appearance for desired locales, to display in the user interface
  • The author of the appearance.
  • The descriptions of the appearance for desired locales, to display in the user interface.
  • The date of creation of the appearance.
  • The date of the last modification of the appearance.
  • The representative icon for the appearance.

The icon must be an instance of MediaObject representing an image in one of the mandatory image formats as defined in the "Customizable elements" section of this specification (in "File Format Reference").

The titles and descriptions are passed as instances of Hashtable where the keys are String objects that represent the locale identifiers, and the values are String objects that represent the titles or descriptions. When the title or description is requested, the value in the hashtable corresponding to the locale identifier is returned. If there is no value for the locale, the value corresponding to the default locale is returned. This implies that there must be a title and description for the locale passed as the defaultLocale value to the constructor.

Applications can get the title or description for the default locale by using the getDefaultLocale method and passing it as the parameter to getTitle or getDescription.

Constructor Detail

ThemeMetadata

public ThemeMetadata(java.util.Hashtable titles,
                     java.util.Hashtable descriptions,
                     java.lang.String defaultLocale,
                     java.lang.String author,
                     java.util.Date created,
                     java.util.Date modified,
                     MediaObject icon)

Constructs a collection of metadata associated with an appearance. All metadata attributes are mandatory except for the icon, which is optional. The locale strings used must be in RFC 3066 format (see [LangTags]) as specified in the File Format Reference.

If a MediaObject for the icon is supplied, it must be a valid image file, otherwise it must be discarded and the icon property must be set to null.

Parameters:
titles - the titles for different locales
descriptions - the descriptions for different locales
defaultLocale - the default locale identifier
author - the name of the author
created - the date of creation of the appearance
modified - the date of the last modification of the appearance
icon - the representative icon of this appearance
Throws:
java.lang.IllegalArgumentException - if any string parameter is empty or a hashtable parameter has no elements, or if the hashtable keys and values are not java.lang.String instances, or one of the keys is not defaultLocale
java.lang.NullPointerException - if any parameter except the optional icon is null
